title: 6.5 Inequalities in One Triangle

icans: I can list the angles of a triangle in order when I know the side lengths.
I can list the sides of a triangle in order when I know the angle measures.
I can decide whether three lengths can form a triangle and find the possible lengths of a third side.

vocab: the side of the ___________ that does not touch the angle
the angle ___________ the longer side is larger
the side ___________ the larger angle is longer
the sum of any two side __________ of a triangle is greater than the third side length

blocks.p: Measure. Use a ruler to draw a scalene triangle (all sides different). Measure each side and each angle. Circle the longest side and the largest angle.
Build. Try to make a triangle with each set of strips.
Three lengths make a triangle when ____________________________________

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Triangle Longer Side Theorem: If one side of a triangle is longer than another side, then the angle _______________ the longer side is _______________.

blocks.stem: List the angles of △JKL in order from smallest to largest.

notes: Triangle Larger Angle Theorem: If one angle is larger than another angle, then the side opposite the larger angle is _______________.

blocks.stem: List the sides of △ABC in order from shortest to longest.

notes: Triangle Inequality Theorem: The sum of the lengths of any two sides of a triangle is _______________ than the length of the third side.
